newsitem.title: UK: North Petro to buy interest in Kazakh wells.
newsitem.headline: North Petro to buy interest in Kazakh wells.

text.p: Britain's Northern Petroleum said on Wednesday it planned to acquire the full interest of Gulf Eastern in the Zhetybay, Azar and East Zhetybay oilfields in western Kazakstan.
It is estimated that the principal field, Zhetybay, contains 2.6 billion barrels of original oil-in-place, some 15 percent of which has been produced to date.

Gulf Eastern currently holds its interest in Zhetybay as shareholder in Quest Petroleum Kazakhstan GmbH. QPK holds a 50 percent interest in the Zhetybay-Quest joint venture with other 50 percent being held by the Kazakh company Mangistaumunaygaz.

Northern will acquire an initial 50 percent interest in QPK for a consideration of $8.0 million, payable in cash. The British firm will have an option to purchase the remaining 50 percent of QPK for $9.0 million.
